requests.title: Judge journey assertions whose prerequisite slices are not integrated yet
requests.question: The slice gate (tools/requirements-compiler/src/Ledger.fs, journeys rule) requires every assertion bound to a slice to pass before it merges. Several bound assertions need slices that depend on the slice itself (SL-T16 shell: J2-08, J3-01, J3-02, J3-08, J3-09; SL-T19: J1-04, J1-05, J3-05, J3-07; EXT-DATA and INV-START both carry J1-03), so as specified the approved plan deadlocks. How should such an assertion be judged?
options: A: judge a bound assertion at a slice gate only once every slice its journey steps need is integrated; otherwise judge it at the next gate where they are, and always at release (the completion gate is unchanged)
B: rebind each such assertion to the slice that completes its path (a successor slice manifest)
C: keep the rule as it is (the run deadlocks at SL-T16)
requests.recommendation: A. It keeps every assertion and the release gate intact and removes the deadlock without rewriting the bindings. Independently confirmed by the optimization agent (PR #119, CROSS-AGENT-FINDINGS.md).
requests.rationale: Pre-existing in the approved plan; independent of the contract-first proposal.
requests.impact: A or B is required before any rehearsal can complete; C leaves the critical path blocked. A changes slice-gate code (reviewed PR).

requests.title: Adopt the UI contract package (IF-UI) and the build-before-merge start rule
requests.question: Ship proposals/r10-contract-first-ui/contracts and fixtures in the next successor package (bootstrap writes them to src/Causa.App/Ui/Contracts and tests/Causa.TestSupport/UiFixtures), and let a UI slice START once bootstrap is integrated and its UI predecessors are built, while MERGING stays exactly as gated?
options: A: adopt in the next successor package (v4.1.5); STARTUP-INSTRUCTIONS section 4 gains the build-before-merge rule for UI slices
B: do not adopt; v4.1.4's start rule and ownership stand
requests.recommendation: A, for Rehearsal 011 (a v4.1.5 freeze cannot complete before an R10 launch this morning). Under OD-INDY-22 the contracts and fixtures enter a run only as frozen-package content.
requests.rationale: Verified: the contracts and screens compile unchanged in the real v4.1.4 bootstrap with domain stubs only (proposals/r10-contract-first-ui/evidence/bootstrap-compile.log).
requests.impact: First non-shell UI start moves from about T+189/252 to T+45 (model). Merge timing is decided by CF-07 and the queue.

requests.title: Number of UI agents
requests.question: How many UI agents should the successor plan run, given the FILE-OWNERSHIP.json split?
options: A: three UI agents (ui-a browsing, ui-b editing, ui-c analysis), together with speculative verification at queue depth 3 (ODR-R10-22)
B: two UI agents (the FILE-OWNERSHIP two-agent variant)
C: keep the v4.1.4 ownership (ui-1, ui-2)
requests.recommendation: A if ODR-R10-22 is adopted, otherwise B. Never one UI agent.
requests.rationale: In the optimization agent's model, three UI agents with a depth-3 queue is the only configuration that puts Data Visible, Understood and Editable inside 420 minutes at every CI value (T+278-380; all integrated T+435-518). Without the queue, two and three differ little.
requests.impact: A and B need the successor ownership (ODR-R10-20/-21 in PR #119).

requests.title: Per-screen markup fragments
requests.question: Limen renders hand-written HTML bound by data-* names, so all markup lives in HTML. Should each screen own a fragment?
options: A: web/screens/<screen>.html and .css, each owned by its UI role, included into web/index.html by integration's build.fsx
B: keep one integration-owned web/index.html; every markup change is a change request to integration
requests.rationale: Under B every UI agent queues on the integration lane for every template edit.
requests.impact: A changes the frozen ownership rule for web/index.html (successor package).

requests.title: Catalog entries for actions the journeys use
requests.question: J2-03 activates 'Record evidence' and J2-06 'Reassess'; J2-04 picks evidence and hypothesis from comboboxes. No catalog entry names them. Add them?
options: A: add catalog entries in the successor catalog (an action each, and the two choosers)
B: keep them journey-only (SCREEN-MANIFEST ids UIA-RECORD-EVIDENCE, UIA-REASSESS, UIF-LINK-*)
requests.rationale: Dokimos catalog acceptance cannot check an element no entry names.

requests.title: When the hypothesis explanation (INV-011) is required
requests.question: The catalog marks INV-011 required, but J2-02 records hypotheses with the statement only. Which holds?
options: A: required in the hypothesis detail editor (S04), optional when a hypothesis is first recorded
B: required always; journey J2 must fill it
C: optional
requests.recommendation: A or C: the owner's call. The agent does not weaken a requirement.
requests.rationale: Today an implementation that enforces the catalog fails J2-02.

requests.title: Routes no document fixes
requests.question: Administration has no path in any document, and investigation sections could be a query parameter (S02 tab) or sub-routes (S03 style). Which?
options: A: #/administration; sections as #/investigations/{id}?tab=<section>
B: #/administration; sections as sub-routes #/investigations/{id}/<section>
requests.rationale: J2-08 and J3-01 judge aria-current, not paths.

requests.title: Which preferences Settings offers
requests.question: UI-019 lists kinds of settings, not settings, and J3-02 needs a radio, checkbox or combobox in Settings. Which preferences, with which scope?
options: A: Reduce motion (device scope: system/on/off) as the only preference for now
B: the owner supplies the list (record it in the decision's PR)
requests.recommendation: A as a minimum, or B.
requests.rationale: Without a decision the Settings slice cannot be built without inventing scope.

requests.title: Contrast of UI-016 teal with ivory text
requests.question: Ivory #F5F3ED on teal #087F8C is 4.27:1, below 4.5:1 for normal text (axe-core, first render). How is it resolved?

B: teal only behind large text and non-text indicators
requests.rationale: UI-016 allows derived tokens after measuring contrast.
